card.title: Only You Can Know
card.instruction: Treat one person as the only safe place for your honest reactions, while hiding how much their discretion determines what you can risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Close the office door. I hated the director's presentation. You're the only person I can say that to.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He asked me to collect feedback.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put me down as engaged. This is just us having coffee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thanks. The standing ovation felt like a hostage video. More coffee?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 confines an honest reaction to B behind a closed door, A3 hides it from formal feedback, and A5 risks a sharper judgment once B promises exclusion.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's feedback duty causes A3's engaged cover; B4's discretion promise enables A5's stronger criticism disguised as more coffee.

relationship.evidence: B2 reveals a relevant reporting obligation and B4 agrees to keep the comments out.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's protection to say something riskier while minimizing the exchange as ordinary refreshment.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes private office criticism of the director's presentation; B2 makes disclosure consequential.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's coffee tag continues A3's this-is-just-coffee cover after the stronger comparison.
